displayPattern: Washer display shows LC (also shown as 1E, LE, 1C, LC1, 1 1C or 1 LC on some models)
meaning: Water level or leakage error: moisture is detected somewhere it should not be, or there is an issue with the sensor itself.
causes: A leak, sometimes so small it goes unnoticed
Too much detergent or non-HE detergent creating suds
diySteps: Look for evidence of a leak; if you find one, fixing the leak fixes the error
Check that the supply hoses and drain hose behind the washer are not kinked. Do not remove the screw on the back that holds the drain hose against the washer

Run an empty cycle with no additives (detergent, fabric softener, etc.) and watch for suds. If they appear, too much detergent or a non-HE detergent has been used; keep running empty cycles until the suds are gone, then check whether the code returns
safetyNote: Unplug the washer (or switch off its breaker) and close the water taps before you reach behind it, handle hoses or open a filter. Water left from a recent hot cycle can be very hot, so let it cool first. Never bypass the door lock. Motor, pump, valve, sensor and control-board repairs belong to a qualified appliance technician.
proAdvice: If no suds appear but the code continues, Samsung says to request service.
sourceTitle: Samsung washing machine information and error codes (Samsung Support)
